connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.description: Connect external AI assistants and automation tools directly to your Ringee account. Connectors expose your Ringee data and actions (calls, contacts, callbacks, meetings) through a standardized protocol so any compatible client can use them.

mcp.description: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets AI clients like Claude Desktop, ChatGPT and other agents read and act on your Ringee data. Paste the URL below into your client to connect.
mcp.loadError: Could not load MCP connection info
mcp.scopeOrganization: This URL gives access to the active organization.
mcp.scopeFreelancer: This URL gives access to your personal (freelancer) workspace.

security.title: Treat this URL as a secret
security.description: Anyone with this URL can read and act on your Ringee data via MCP. Only share it with trusted AI clients. If it leaks, contact support to rotate your account.

howTo.title: How to connect
howTo.step2: Open your MCP-compatible client (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) and add a new remote MCP server.
howTo.step3: Paste the URL as the SSE endpoint. No additional API key is required — the URL is the credential.
howTo.step4: Once connected, the client will see Ringee tools for searching contacts, starting calls, scheduling callbacks and meetings, and logging outcomes.
